en.name: Ham deli meat, pre-packaged
en.summary: Pre-packaged ham deli meat is pork cured with salt and nitrite, cooked, then sliced and sealed. The cure is what fixes the pink colour and what lowers the water available to bacteria — though not by enough to change the dates. A sealed pack keeps 2 weeks from purchase at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, and 3–5 days once opened. Freezing is not recommended for quality, although an unopened pack will hold 1–2 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F).
en.pantry: There is no room-temperature figure for sliced ham, and the salt and nitrite in it do not buy you one. Modern deli ham is a high-moisture product cured for colour and flavour rather than for shelf life, which is a different thing from a dry-cured leg hanging in a cellar. Carry it home cold, in the middle of the bag rather than against a sunny car window, and get it back under 4 °C (40 °F). Anything already out has 2 hours, cut to 1 hour once the room passes 32 °C (90 °F). The usual failure is a plate of ham left on the table through a party.
en.fridge: Sealed, 2 weeks from the day you bought it at 4 °C (40 °F) or below; opened, 3–5 days. Press the slices back together and roll the pack tight, or move them into a small lidded box — ham exposed to air dries into hard-edged curls and the cured pink fades towards brown-grey. Keep it below and apart from anything raw. One thing that looks alarming and is not: ham slices often show a green-gold shimmer where the blade cut across the muscle fibres, which is light diffracting off the cut ends, not spoilage. What does mean discard is a tacky, sticky surface, cloudy liquid collecting in the pack, or a sour whey smell. Anyone pregnant, elderly or immunocompromised should heat it until steaming or leave it — cooked non-dried deli meats are named in that advice, while dry-cured products are treated separately.
en.freezer: Freezing is not recommended, and the cure is the reason. Salt speeds up the oxidation of fat, so frozen ham picks up a stale, rancid edge sooner than fresh pork would, and the injected brine leaves the thawed slices weeping, soft, saltier and inclined to tear as you peel them apart. If you freeze it anyway, an unopened pack holds 1–2 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F). Do it while most of the fridge window is still unspent, lay the pack flat, and send the thawed slices into something cooked — a croque monsieur, a quiche — where the wetness does not show.
en.thawing: Thaw the pack overnight in the fridge, and count the 3–5 opened days from the moment you break the seal. Never leave it on the counter, and do not refreeze slices that have softened.
spoilage: A slimy or tacky film on the slices — the earliest reliable sign.
A sour, sulphurous or ammonia-like smell when the pack is opened.
Grey, green or iridescent patches, or dried dark edges.
A puffed pack, or cloudy ropy liquid inside it.
tips: Write the opening date on the pack; the sealed figure does not carry over.
Keep it on a cold shelf, never in the fridge door.
Take out what you need and reseal rather than leaving the pack open.
Heat until steaming if you are pregnant or immunocompromised.

faq.q: How long does packaged sliced ham keep?
faq.a: 2 weeks from purchase unopened in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, and 3–5 days once opened.
It is not recommended — the slices come back wet and soft. If you do, an unopened pack holds 1–2 months from purchase at −18 °C.

faq.q: Is deli ham safe during pregnancy?
faq.a: Non-dried deli meats such as cooked ham are on the list to avoid, because of Listeria. Heating them until steaming hot first is the usual advice if you want to eat them.

zh.name: 包裝火腿切片
zh.summary: 包裝火腿切片是豬肉用鹽和亞硝酸鹽醃製、加熱煮熟後切片密封的產品。醃製既是它維持粉紅色的原因，也降低了細菌可用的水分——但還不足以改變下面這些天數。未開封自購買日起放 4 °C 以下 2 週，開封後 3～5 天。基於品質不建議冷凍，未開封的包裝在 −18 °C 下自購買日起可放 1～2 個月。
zh.pantry: 火腿切片沒有室溫天數，裡面的鹽和亞硝酸鹽也換不到室溫天數。現在的即食火腿含水量高，醃製是為了顏色和風味，不是為了常溫保存，跟吊在陰涼處慢慢風乾的生火腿是兩回事。買回家路上要保冷，放在購物袋中間，不要貼著曬得到太陽的車窗，回家立刻收進 4 °C 以下。已經拿出來的最多 2 小時，室溫超過 32 °C 時只剩 1 小時。最常出事的情境，就是一盤火腿在聚會桌上擺一整晚。
zh.fridge: 未開封自購買日起 4 °C 以下 2 週；開封後 3～5 天。把肉片疊回去、包裝捲緊夾好，或改裝進小的密封盒——暴露在空氣裡的火腿會乾成硬邊捲片，醃出來的粉紅也會褪成灰褐。位置要在生食下方，而且分開放。有一種看起來嚇人但其實沒事的現象：火腿切面常出現綠金色的虹彩光澤，那是光線在被刀切斷的肌纖維末端產生繞射，不是變質。真正該丟的是表面發黏、袋裡積出混濁液體，或聞到酸酸的乳清味。懷孕、年長或免疫功能低下者請加熱到冒蒸氣再吃，或直接避開——被點名的正是這類加熱熟製的非乾式肉品，乾式鹽漬的產品另當別論。
zh.freezer: 不建議冷凍，而原因就出在醃製本身。鹽會加速油脂氧化，所以冷凍火腿產生油耗味的速度比生豬肉還快；注射進去的鹽水則讓解凍後的肉片一直滲水，回來時軟爛、更鹹，一撕就破。真的要凍，未開封的包裝在 −18 °C 下自購買日起 1～2 個月。請趁冷藏期限還剩很多的時候就凍、包裝平放，解凍後用在加熱料理裡——火腿起司熱吐司、鹹派——出水就看不出來了。
zh.thawing: 整包移到冷藏放隔夜解凍，而開封後的 3～5 天要從撕開封口那一刻起算。不要放在流理台上退冰，已經軟掉的肉片也不要再冰回冷凍庫。
spoilage: 肉片表面出現黏滑或發黏的薄膜——最早也最可靠的徵兆。
拆封時聞到酸味、硫味或氨味。
出現灰色、綠色或虹彩光澤的斑，或邊緣乾黑。
包裝鼓脹，或裡面的汁液變混濁牽絲。
tips: 在包裝上寫開封日期，未開封的數字不能延用。
放冷藏層架，絕對不要放門邊。
要用多少拿多少再封回去，不要整包開著。
懷孕或免疫功能低下者，請加熱到冒蒸氣再吃。

faq.q: 包裝火腿片可以放多久？
faq.a: 未開封自購買日起冷藏 4 °C 以下 2 週，開封後 3～5 天。
不建議，解凍後會濕軟。真要冷凍，未開封包裝在 −18 °C 下自購買日起 1～2 個月。

faq.q: 懷孕可以吃即食火腿嗎？
faq.a: 熟火腿這類非乾式熟肉因李斯特菌風險被列入建議避免的清單。若要吃，通常建議先加熱到冒蒸氣。
